newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends down despite bullish news.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends down despite bullish news.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL
Mar (3rd pos) 1,291 rgt/tonne Jan (south) 1,350
Open/Hi/Low 1,291/1,304/1,284 Prev close 1,352.50
Prev settlement 1,298 * sellers prices

PALM OIL FUTURES - News of lower-than-expected end-Dec stocks and a reduction in China palm oil import duty helped the market to firm in early afternoon. But prices closed lower on profit-taking in volatile dealing. Morning prices eased on lower soyoil. March touched 1,304 but fell back to 1,291.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Prices were quoted slightly down despite some covering in early afternoon dealing.

PORLA put palm oil stocks at the end of December 1996 at 792,687 tonnes, down 17.08 percent from 955,958 tonnes at end-November. This compared with private crop forecaster Ivan Wong's estimate of 805,000 tonnes.
PORLA said output fell 16.35 percent to 637,865 tonnes in December, while exports were 637,899 tonnes. The figures were released after the morning trading session had ended.

"Stocks were smaller than expected and had helped prices in the afternoon," said one trader. "But I don't think prices will jump very much as the lower stocks were due to a very high local disappearance rather than good exports."
Traders said players turned cautious at the higher levels and took profits. "Players were unsure of the near-term direction," a trader said.
Prices fell in the morning as higher than expected December output estimated by the Malaysian Oil Palm Growers' Council (MOPGC) gave players an excuse to take profits after Monday's surge.
MOPGC put production in December at 642,000 tonnes, compared with Ivan Wong's estimate of 630,000 tonnes.
January futures fell 15 ringgit to 1,315 ringgit a tonne on further liquidation on its expiry day.
Third month March futures closed seven ringgit lower at 1,291 ringgit ($520.98) a tonne after trading between 1,284 and 1,304 ringgit.
Physical Jan (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,350 against bids at 1,347.50 after trading from 1,340 to 1,350 .

Jan (central) was offered at 1,345 and bids at 1,337.50 with trades of 1,335 to 1,345. Jan (north) was offered at 1,320 and bid at 1,317.50. Feb (south) saw offers at 1,350 with bids at 1,345 with earlier trades from 1,340 to 1,350. Feb (central) was offered at 1,340 and bids at 1,325.
Among refined products, Jan RBD palm oil was offered at $570 a tonne FOB Malaysia and Feb/Mar at $565. Feb was traded at $560.
Jan RBD palm olein saw offers at $600, Feb at $597.50 and Mar at $590. Feb was traded at $592.50 and Mar at $590.
Jan/Feb/Mar RBD palm stearin was offered at $435, and Jan/Feb/Mar palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $300.
